## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution in a few focused sentences.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend verification passes (`backend/mvnw verify` or `backend\mvnw.cmd verify`).
- [ ] Frontend formatting, lint, tests, and production build pass.
- [ ] Docker image or Compose behavior was checked when infrastructure changed.
- [ ] API documentation, Postman examples, and screenshots were updated when relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal data, or generated build output were committed.

## Evidence

List commands run, relevant test cases, and screenshots for visual changes.
